title: Create poag-server subflake with business logic
description:
Milestone 2a: Build poag-server flake that:
- Consumes poag-api-server from poag-api flake (FastAPI server)
- Implements session management with SQLite in XDG_DATA_HOME
- Session storage pattern: ${XDG_DATA_HOME}/poag/sessions.db
- Uses dependency injection for storage (like trifolium's Home class)
- Responds to POST /sessions with full session_id (cwd.pid.counter)
- Counter increments based on existing sessions for same cwd/pid pair
- Tests verify business logic works with generated API
- Session IDs used for OTEL tracing correlation

title: Create poag-ui React app with TypeScript client
description:
Milestone 3: Build poag-ui flake that:
- Extends poag-api to generate TypeScript client (poag-api-client-ts)
- Creates React-based web UI
- Consumes poag-api-client-ts for server communication
- Regenerates TS client code from poag.json (automation in flake)
- Checks generated TS client code into version control
- Provides web interface for poag commands (plan, ask, view sessions)
- Tests verify UI can communicate with poag-server

title: Create poag-api subflake with OpenAPI spec and code generation
description:
Milestone 1: Build poag-api flake with:
- OpenAPI spec (poag.json) with /hello endpoint
- Fern-based Python client generation (poag-api-client-py)
- datamodel-code-generator + FastAPI server (poag-api-server)
- pytest tests that build both via nix and test client+server communication
- Export poag.json as flake output
- All code generation ephemeral (nix store only)
- Consumer flakes will check in their generated code

title: Integrate poag-server and poag-client into main poag CLI
description:
Milestone 4: Wire everything into main poag CLI:
- Update main poag flake to depend on poag-server and poag-client
- Implement 'poag serve' to start poag-server in background
- Implement 'poag status' to check server health
- Implement 'poag stop' to stop server
- Use poag-client for all CLI commands (plan, ask, etc.)
- Implement session management using client library
- Add 'poag view' to open browser to poag-ui
- Tests verify full end-to-end workflow: CLI → client → server → response

title: Create poag-client subflake with business logic
description:
Milestone 2b: Build poag-client flake that:
- Consumes poag-api-client-py from poag-api flake (Python client)
- Derives partial session ID from cwd and pid  
- Posts to /sessions endpoint to get full session_id with counter
- Provides convenience wrapper for session management
- Uses dependency injection pattern for testability
- Tests verify client can communicate with poag-server
- Client handles session ID for OTEL correlation in ask/plan commands
